issues.on_page: General Fund Other 52,068 = Sales tax 33,594 + Expense reimbursements 12,259 + Other 5,527 + Interest on investments 688 (p10)
issues.issue: The statement line Other holds 33,594 of General Fund sales tax, printed as 'Sales tax' on the p10 schedule, plus 12,259 of reimbursements. Together these are 61% of the line. They stay in other, so governmental sales tax is understated by 33,594 (only the Street Fund's 33,594 is recorded as sales tax). No single category passes 50% (sales tax is 44%), so leaving the line in other follows the rule, but a split using the printed p10/p27 breakdown is possible.

issues.on_page: Charges for services 84,644 = Disposal Service Fund disposal fees 79,884 + Park 2,010 + community room rent 1,500 + grave openings 1,250
issues.issue: 94% of the line is disposal (refuse) fees. Under the mixed-line rule the dominant category would be Utility Charges, which is what the matching detail line uses (detail[147]). The statement line and the detail line are categorized differently.

issues.on_page: Public Works - other 39,849 = Street Lights 19,450 + Cemetery 20,399
issues.issue: A mixed line should take its dominant category. Cemetery (20,399, health/welfare) is larger than street lights (19,450, streets/highways).

issues.on_page: Community/economic development 27,832 (Keno Lottery Fund: Community improvement 16,186, Gaming tax 6,346, Donations 5,200, Supplies 100, p26)
issues.issue: This is keno-fund community improvement spending. The user's rules make Community Betterment its own category ('Community development/betterment' -> Community Betterment), which may fit better than economic development. The same applies to detail[150] (Community improvement 16,186).

issues.on_page: Restricted for: Debt service 83,212; Permanent funds 18,001; Capital projects/outlay 64,393; Consumer deposits 14,189; Unrestricted 729,234 / 194,178
issues.issue: None of the six equity lines (equity[0]-[5]) has a category field. Amounts are correct and sum to the total 1,103,207.
